results.name: NT-19: native collection download/file import round-trips fields into new indexed IDs; invalid/cancelled import changes nothing
NT-20: merge checked saved snapshots into a new note; an unsaved source draft and both original records remain exact
NT-21: split the current draft at real top-level headings, ignore fenced headings, preserve every source character and support cancellation
NT-22: native find-next selects/wraps actual textarea matches; literal replace saves exact Unicode and empty find is refused
NT-23: real selection + link form inserts a safe encoded Markdown anchor; active schemes fail without altering the draft
NT-24: table builder validates dimensions; native saved preview renders escaped cells/alignment without interpreting HTML
NT-25: save a real VFS template and instantiate its local text tokens into a distinct indexed note without rewriting source/template
NT-26: compare with a real concurrent saved winner; modal contains keyboard focus/blocks live tiling and never silently accepts its revision
NT-22/23 patch attack: a CRLF source find selects the visible Unicode match and link replacement preserves every other source byte
NT-27: cross-note saved task rollup ignores fences, commits exact task markers and rejects a stale row instead of overwriting a real winner
NT-27 patch attack: an own Save inserting a line cannot retarget the old rollup checkbox to another source line
Large-text patch attack: the real async comparison heading follows saved 125/200 percent settings and remains closeable
Native Notes workflow pages emitted no unhandled browser exceptions
